items.title: Is Visa (V) Trading At A Discount As Stablecoin Scale Grows?
items.summary: Visa has delivered a 65.6% return over the past 5 years. With the shares now near US$361, the real question for investors is whether that price is adequately grounded in the returns the business earns on its capital. That 65.6% gain over 5 years places more focus on whether Visa's ability to generate excess returns on the money it invests is strong enough to support the current valuation. items.title: Americans Would Use Stablecoins—If They Came With Bank Protections, Visa Study Finds
items.summary: A Visa survey found U.S. willingness to use stablecoins for cross-border transfers rises from 36% to 56% when paired with hypothetical bank-level fraud protection and deposit insurance.
